result.title: Intra-Class Diversity Loss for Person Re-Identification
result.summary: Person re-identification (ReID) aims to retrieve images of the same pedestrian across different cameras. However, the non-overlapping identities between training and testing sets, together with large intra-class variation, make it challenging to learn generalizable pedestrian representations. Most existing ReID loss functions mainly focus on intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, which may overlook useful intra-class differences. To address these issues, we propose a novel Intra-Class Diversity (ICD) loss that aims to maximize intra-class differences in classification-irrelevant directions. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce this class-weight-orthogonal diversity learning objective for person ReID. Specifically, based on the geometric relationship between the learned representation and its corresponding class-weight vector, we decompose each representation into the component along the class-weight direction and its orthogonal component. This decomposition provides a clear and interpretable geometric basis for modeling intra-class diversity. ICD then encour- ages larger differences among the orthogonal components of samples belonging to the same identity, while the classification loss maintains identity discrimination. The proposed ICD loss can be incorporated into existing ReID frameworks as an additional regularization term without modifying the feature extraction network. Extensive experiments on three widely used ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ICD and its complementarity with existing metric learning losses.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种 Intra-Class Diversity 损失：把表征按几何关系分解为沿类权重方向的分量与正交分量，在同身份样本的正交分量之间鼓励差异，并配合分类损失保持判别性，作为额外正则项接入现有行人重识别框架。
AI.relevance_reason: 「沿任务判别方向 vs. 正交方向」的显式分解与正交子空间多样性约束，可能可供核查 LVR 隐状态中视觉细节被答案方向压缩、信息坍缩的问题，但论文属纯视觉 ReID、无多模态推理与 latent 生成，迁移价值需要较多判断。
